news.paragraph: USO has seen significant upward momentum as WTI crude oil prices surpassed $89 per barrel, building on a trend where crude has outperformed stocks in 2026. This surge is supported by strong U.S. economic growth and follows news of the UAE exiting OPEC+, which has contributed to oil holding above $100 at times. The United States Oil Fund has already seen gains exceeding 100% this year, indicating a bullish sentiment driven by commodity prices.
